evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/routes/groups/meters.tsx:163-174 — useAllMeters() derives the building fan-out from useBuildings(): `const buildingIds = (buildingsData?.items ?? []).map(b => b.id)`, runs one useQueries entry per building, and returns `isLoading = buildingIds.length > 0 && results.some(r => r.isLoading)`. The `buildingIds.length > 0` guard is the defect. (1) LOADING FLASH: while the parent useBuildings() query is still in flight, buildingsData is undefined, buildingIds is [], useQueries([]) yields [], so isLoading evaluates to `false && ... = false` and meters is []. MetersPageRoute (:177-190) therefore passes meters=[] isLoading=false to <MetersPage>, which renders its 'no meters' empty state for the whole initial-buildings-load window, then flips to a spinner once buildings resolve and the per-building queries start — a reversed/false empty-state flash on every cold load of /meters. (2) MORE SERIOUS — ERROR SWALLOWED AS ZERO: useBuildings() exposes no isError/error here, and on a buildings-fetch failure buildingsData stays undefined forever, so buildingIds stays [], isLoading stays false, meters stays [] permanently. A failed buildings request is thus indistinguishable from a tenant who legitimately has zero meters: the user is shown a settled 'No meters' screen with no loading and no error affordance. Same misleading-empty class as the already-tracked financial-dash-false-zeros finding, but in a distinct file/hook (meters.tsx useAllMeters fan-out) not covered by any existing code-review-ppt-web-core-* id. Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): treat the parent-buildings phase as loading/error explicitly — e.g. `const { data: buildingsData, isLoading: isLoadingBuildings, isError: isBuildingsError } = useBuildings();` then `const isLoading = isLoadingBuildings || results.some(r => r.isLoading);` and surface isBuildingsError (plus results.some(r => r.isError)) so the page can show an error state instead of a false empty one; the `buildingIds.length > 0` short-circuit should be dropped. Add a hook test asserting isLoading===true while useBuildings is pending and that a buildings error does not resolve to an empty, done-loading meters list.
